title: Families and Friends
bigQuestion: Who are your family and friends?
pages: Student Book pp. 7–15（Big Question p7；读前 p9；阅读 pp.10–12；语法 p13；词汇/听力 p14；写作 p15）
objectives: 认读家庭词汇：mother, father, brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather, family, friend, uncle, aunt, cousin, parents, son, daughter
用 verb be 说简单句：I'm / He's / She's / My family is / Friends are
能连续说 3–5 句介绍自己和家人
grammar: Verb Be: I'm / He's / She's / My family is / Friends are
lessonFlow: Warm-up（p7）：family big or small / friend's name
Words（p14）：uncle, aunt, cousin, parents, son, daughter
Grammar（p13）：verb be 例句 + 填空

tasks.prompt: Is your family big or small? What is your friend's name? Tell me in English. (Book p7)
Who lives with you? Use: parents, brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather. (Book p14)

tasks.passage: Kim is six years old. Her family is small. She lives with her mother. Friends play together. They share things.
tasks.question: Is Kim's family big or small?

tasks.script: This is my aunt. She has two sons and a daughter.
tasks.question: How many sons does she have?

tasks.prompt: Introduce yourself: I'm ... I'm ... years old. My family is ... . (Book p13)
Write 3 sentences about your family. Use: I'm… My family is… I have… (Book p15)

assessment.note: 课堂表现计入真实学习记录；60% 以上达标。
